scripts.build: bun scripts/run-if-sources.ts build -- bun run --filter '*' build
scripts.typecheck: bun scripts/run-if-sources.ts typecheck -- bun run --filter '*' typecheck
scripts.render:example: bun run packages/cli/src/index.ts render examples/basic-line/chart.vl.json --theme paper-clean --format svg --out examples/basic-line/output.svg
scripts.infer:examples: bun run infer:training-curve && bun run infer:training-curve-aggregate && bun run infer:confusion-matrix && bun run infer:confusion-matrix-trials && bun run infer:faceted-training
scripts.infer:training-curve: bun run packages/cli/src/index.ts infer examples/training-curve/data.csv --chart line --x epoch --y f1 --color model --title "Training F1" --spec-out examples/training-curve/chart.vl.json
scripts.infer:training-curve-aggregate: bun run packages/cli/src/index.ts infer examples/training-curve/runs.csv --chart line --x epoch --y f1 --color model --aggregate mean --title "Training F1 (mean over runs)" --spec-out examples/training-curve/chart-aggregate.vl.json
scripts.infer:confusion-matrix: bun run packages/cli/src/index.ts infer examples/confusion-matrix/data.csv --chart heatmap --x predicted --y actual --color count --title "Confusion matrix" --spec-out examples/confusion-matrix/chart.vl.json
scripts.infer:confusion-matrix-trials: bun run packages/cli/src/index.ts infer examples/confusion-matrix/trials.csv --chart heatmap --x predicted --y actual --color n --aggregate sum --title "Confusion matrix (from trials)" --spec-out examples/confusion-matrix/chart-from-trials.vl.json
scripts.infer:faceted-training: bun run packages/cli/src/index.ts infer examples/faceted-training/data.csv --chart line --x epoch --y f1 --color model --facet split --title "F1 by split" --spec-out examples/faceted-training/chart.vl.json
scripts.render:training-curve: bun run packages/cli/src/index.ts render examples/training-curve/chart.vl.json --theme paper-clean --format svg --out examples/training-curve/output.svg
scripts.render:confusion-matrix: bun run packages/cli/src/index.ts render examples/confusion-matrix/chart.vl.json --theme paper-clean --format svg --out examples/confusion-matrix/output.svg
scripts.render:faceted-training: bun run packages/cli/src/index.ts render examples/faceted-training/chart.vl.json --theme paper-clean --format svg --out examples/faceted-training/output.svg
